A set of modifier keys that are evaluated together based on a specified operator.

Examples

Any combination of modifier keys is allowed. However, gamepad-related modifier keys only function with gamepad-related input.

For example, while "[Shift] + Right Bumper" is technically valid, the order and context matter: "[Right Bumper] + Shift" does not work because gamepad modifiers require a gamepad input context. Combinations like "[Shift] + Left Mouse Button" or "[Middle Mouse Button] + Space" are valid, as they involve keyboard or mouse modifiers. Always ensure that gamepad modifiers are paired with gamepad inputs for correct behavior.

So you can pair any modifier type with gamepad input, but gamepad modifiers will only work with gamepad input.

Remarks

This class is used to define combinations of modifier keys (like Shift, Ctrl, Alt) that must be active for an input to be triggered. The keys can be combined using either an AND or an OR logic.

IsActive(GamepadDevice?)

Checks if the modifier key set is currently active.

public bool IsActive(GamepadDevice? gamepad = null)

Parameters

gamepad GamepadDevice

The gamepad device to check against. If null, only keyboard/mouse modifiers are considered. Default is null.

Returns

bool

true if the conditions of the modifier set are met; otherwise, false.

Remarks

If the set is empty, this method returns true. (No modifier keys means no restrictions, so input should be allowed.)

For And, all keys must be active. For Or, at least one key must be active.
